description: This file contains functions for parsing and extracting comment tags in Go source code, specifically for handling custom comment annotations used in Kubernetes code generation.

methods.name: ExtractCommentTags
methods.description: Parses comment lines for key=value tags with a specified marker prefix.

methods.name: ExtractSingleBoolCommentTag
methods.description: Extracts a boolean tag value from comments, with a default fallback.

methods.name: ExtractFunctionStyleCommentTags
methods.description: Extracts metadata tags from comments, supporting specific marker and tag names.

methods.name: ParseValues
methods.description: Enables parsing of tag values, such as quoted strings, ints, booleans, etc.

methods.name: toStringArgs
methods.description: Converts a codetags.Tag to a custom Tag struct with string arguments.
